messages:
alyssa: quick idea for safetensors/shard warmup: what if we expose a layerwise mmap path + optional encrypted overlay per-shard so warmup can choose: mmap (fast cold read) -> overlay stream (decrypt+patch) -> in-memory delta. goal is fewer full-shard downloads for small deltas and safer hotpatches. thoughts?

devon: hmm sounds promising. are you imagining the overlay to be appended data (like delta tar) or a separate sidecar object?

alyssa: sidecar object per shard (s3/gcs object) containing a list of <layer_idx, byte_range, cipher_blob>. consumer can apply in order. sidecar has a small manifest and signature. if missing, loader falls back to original shard.

maria: big Q: how do we guarantee atomicity when applying overlay during eviction/rollout? we can’t have partially-applied layers.

samir: atomicity q is real. options: 1) write-to-temp then rename in local cache (classic), 2) layer-level versioning + manifest with checksums and a single manifest atomically swapped. I prefer (2) because we can do per-layer fallback.

kevin: perf question: mmap gives zero-copy reads, but decrypting into an overlay means copy. For small deltas probably fine. For big overlays we'd end up rehydrating whole layer -> recompute cost. should we gate overlay size?

alyssa: agreed. propose policy: overlay_size <= 4MB -> apply in-memory; 4MB-100MB -> stream-to-temp-file then swap; >100MB -> prefer full shard download/replace. numbers are placeholders.

maria: what about warmup heuristics? prefer overlay apply when hotstart probability > 0.7 and layer has high access heat. need telemetry signal.

samir: loader API sketch: ``WeightSource.open_shard(shard_id, options={prefetch_hint: low|med|high, overlay_policy: apply|defer|ignore, decrypt_ctx: <keyref>})`` returns a ShardHandle with methods ``read_layer(idx)`` that transparently consults mmap + overlay.

kevin: love the API. but keep options minimal; too many knobs will explode config surface. default should be overlay_policy: apply for small overlays + prefetch_hint derived from route metadata.

alyssa: for security: overlay manifest signed by author and overlay blobs encrypted with customer KMS key id (we store keyref in model manifest). io-bot: mention audit logs?

io-bot: deploybot note: new sidecar objects will need lifecycle rules in ingestion flow. tag: needs-ingest-change.

maria: fallback semantics: if overlay verification fails, loader should log and try fallback path (original shard). alert if repeated failures for same model.

samir: eviction interplay: if overlay applied and then we evict base mmap pages, we need to persist applied result if overlay rewrite policy used or reapply on next access. keep ephemeral by default.

alyssa: proposal for RFC follow-up: 1) define overlay sidecar manifest proto (fields: shard_id, overlay_version, entries[{layer_idx, start, end, checksum, enc_key_ref}]), 2) loader API with prefetch_hint + overlay_policy, 3) size thresholds & default policies, 4) telemetry + alerts.

kevin: also add perf microbench (mmap+overlay apply latency for 1-4 layer patches) as gating criteria before rollout.

maria: +1. can we also include a small CLI for debugging: ``redwood-weights inspect-overlay --shard s3://... --list`` -> prints entries and checksums.

alyssa: good call. i'll draft RFC skeleton and attach perf matrix. next: volunteers for draft? samir/kevin can you take loader API and perf plan, i'll do manifest and ingest changes. maria can do telemetry + alerts.

samir: i'll take loader API.

kevin: i'll own perf plan and microbench harness.

maria: telemetry + alerting, + help with CLI UX.

alyssa: thanks team. I'll post an initial RFC PR by EOD tomorrow and tag this thread. :rocket:
